content: Naatu ayu tounamatar etei kwafe’en tafaram umasusun kwafe’en imaim hibatabat aitih, bebeh hitatar yourabad hai ef etei hifut, saise yourabad men kamar yan nababin nanunuw o riy yan nababin nanunuw o kutor nababin ai hinare’emih.
Naatu tounamatar ta veya yeninane yen nan aitin, God wanatowanin ana kwah bai auman. Fanan aumetawat tounamatar nah kwafe’en me naatu riy bai’afiyin isan ana fair hibai hima’am isah e’af,
“Me, riy naatu ai men kwani’afiyih, kwanama nanan aki God ana akir wairafih nakwetah anikwahenabo.”
Imaibo ayu sabuw bai’ab nah hibikwahen hio anowar, sabuw etei i 144,000 nah hikwahen, nati sabuw i Israel wanawanan big ta ta etei.

Iti ufunamaim anuwanuw nau’umaim kou’ay gagamin na’in men karam boro taniyab, tafaram tutufin etei wanawanan, tafaram ta ta, big ta ta, biyah ta ta, tur ta ta etei urama’ama nanamaim naatu Lamb nanamaim hai faifuw kwes hi’osen umah rabod rourih hibow hibatabat aitih.
Naatu fanah aumetawat na’in hiwow hio,

content.text: “Turobe! Yawas etei i ata God ana urama’ama’amaim ema’am nowan,

content: Tounamatar tutufin etei urama’ama hi’ar bebera’uh, regaregah ai’in naatu sawar yawasih ma’anih kwafe’en hi’ar bebera’uhih hibatabat, yumatah aubabe urama’ama nanamaim hira’iy God hikwafir,

content.text: etei i ata God nowan ema’am wanatowan, wanatowan! Turobe!”

content: Imaibo regaregah ai’in ta ayu ibatiyu, “Iti sabuw hai faifuw kwes hi’osen tebatabat i sabuw iyab? Naatu menane hina tebatabat?”

Ai ya’afut ao, “Regah ayu men aso’ob, baise o i iso’ob.” Naatu iuwu eo, “Iti sabuw i bai’akir kakafin wanawananane hitit, hai faifuw hisouwen naatu Lamb ana rara’amaim kukusouwen hibikwes i hi’osen tebatabat.

content.text: God ana urama’ama nanamaim hibat, fai mar i ana Tafaror Baremaim tebowabow, naatu God nati ana urama’ama’amaim ema’am boro ana taragubamaim natafafarih.
Naatu boro men kafa’imo bayumih hinamorob maiye, naatu boro men sikah namamah maiye.
Veya boro men nararih biyah nababan
naatu boro men nararih biyah hinikakoumih.
Anayabin Lamb urama’ama yan foun tafan ema’am boro hai bonawiyenayan namatar,
nabonawiyih hin harew buruburur yawasin eyey hinatom,
naatu hinarererey God boro maturih etei nasafamen.”
